name: Get Me Out of Here!
label: Quest
description: Melizza Brimbuzzle traveled into the Valley of Spears hoping to do business with the Maraudines, but they would not talk, and she fears they mean to eat…
intro: Melizza Brimbuzzle traveled into the Valley of Spears hoping to do business with the Maraudines, but they would not talk, and she fears they mean to eat her. She asks you to get her out of there; her brother Hornizz will pay you handsomely.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I came up to the Valley of Spears to talk to the Maraudines. I thought I could do a little business with them... But they don't want to talk! I think they want to eat me!
Get me out of here and my brother Hornizz will pay you big! He's at our camp next to the kodo graveyard, to the east.
Let's hurry, friend. Not two minutes ago I heard some centaurs talking about getting wood for their cookpot...

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you seen my sister Melizza? She's always on the go, which gets her into trouble all the time.

clips.title: Completion
paras: My sister Melizza said you'd be coming. Thanks a lot for getting her out of the jam she was in; it's too bad that she's already probably found herself in a new one!
